title: Preprocess Graph (Optional)
description: Convert the graph to an adjacency list representation. For directed graphs, convert to undirected if needed. Optionally sort nodes by degree for optimization.

title: Iterate Over Edges
description: For each edge (u,v), examine the neighbors of both endpoints to identify potential third vertices that could form a triangle.

title: Find Common Neighbors
description: For each edge, find nodes that are connected to both endpoints simultaneously. These common neighbors complete the triangle structure.

title: Identify Unique Triangles
description: Apply deduplication strategy to ensure each triangle {a,b,c} is counted only once, regardless of which edge was examined first.

title: Store or Count Results
description: Either count total triangles, list all unique triangles, or compute triangle-related metrics per node.
